tweets.text: Big win for gun owners and the Second Amendment! We've been pushing the Civilian Marksmanship Program (CMP) to start selling over 100,000 historic M14 rifles to American citizens. After approvals from the Army and ATF, the first sales are now expected to occur in late 2026 or early 2027. Proceeds will fund marksmanship training and youth programs nationwide, including at the new Wyoming State Shooting Complex in Cody, which will partner with CMP. Thanks to the CMP, @atfhq and @secarmy for granting the approvals to make this happen.

Their service and sacrifice mean more than words can express.
